description: This file defines a mock class 'MockOmiProxy' for unit testing, used to simulate the 'omi::IOmiProxy' interface with Google Mock framework.

classes.name: MockOmiProxy
classes.description: A mock implementation of the 'omi::IOmiProxy' interface used for testing.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mocks the mounting of a crypted bundle, returns success status.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mocks the unmounting of a crypted bundle, returns success status.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Mocks registration of an Omi error listener, returns a tag.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Mocks unregistering of an Omi error listener using the given tag.
